## Post · 1/2 — Nahid (@nahid_pro09)

Breaking news free Kimi-K3 extended through august 12😳

If you have been sitting on the sidelines waiting to test a top-tier model without paying a dime, now is your window. freeKimi K3 gives you real access to a frontier-grade LLM through a simple API key no credit card, no subscription, no enterprise deal required

What you get:
- access to moonshotai/kimi-k3-free
- full chat/completion capability
- openAI-compatible endpoint
- zero cost until August 12

Why this matters:
Kimi K3 has been making waves for its long-context reasoning and multilingual strength
Getting hands-on with a model like this for free is rare most free tiers lock you behind rate limits or watermarked outputs
This is the real deal, extended through mid-August, so there is still time to build and test

2-minute setup:
1. get your key
→ http://tokenrouter.com

2. run this
curl https://api.tokenrouter.com/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"moonshotai/kimi-k3-free","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello, test Kimi K3!"}]}'

python version:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="YOUR_KEY",
    base_url="https://api.tokenrouter.com/v1"
)

res = http://client.chat.completions.create(
    model="moonshotai/kimi-k3-free",
    messages=[{"role":"user","content":"Explain RAG in 3 sentences"}]
)
print(res.choices[0].message.content)

caveats:
free access ends August 12. rate limits apply. Not intended for high-volume production workloads treat this as a testing/learning window.

source: http://tokenrouter.com (https://tokenrouter.com/)
